author: DaveCamb
title: Well explained & nice to listen
body: Great podcast which is easy listening & good learning

author: Owen C. Jones
title: Very informative
body: Dense, technically knowledgeable, and very insightful. Mirko manages to assemble a huge amount of information and communicate it on an extraordinarily frequent and timely basis.

author: Lukas Pavelka
title: Simply great
body:
It is great to be part and listen opened thoughts by MVP people from various topics related to Microsoft technologies. 
I would recommend this podcast to everybody who wants to gain tip & tricks or get a hint of interesting tools and applications.

Great job Mirko! 👏

author: HeyAdmin
title: Says the right things out loud!
body: I really like Mirko Peters’ take on management of M365 services. His message is persuasive and articulate. Excellent information.
